ISLAMABAD / RIYADH: Characterising the Makkah Defence Alliance as a "historic" milestone for peace, unity and stability in the region, Prime Minister She­h­baz Sharif on Wednesday reaffirmed Pakistan's "unw­a­vering commitment" to the protection of Saudi Arabia's "sovereignty, territorial integrity and security".

The statement came as powerful explosions rattled the Saudi capital, hours after a Houthi strike hit a building in the area housing energy giant Aramco's operations centre, in a fresh escalation of the war between the kingdom and the Yemeni rebel group.

Most strikes on Saudi Arabia have targeted infrastructure on the outskirts of the capital, but the barrages appear to be getting closer to the city centre.

In the city's downtown, residents have been seen parking their cars to stop and look up at the sky, an AFP journalist said.

On Tuesday night, the white plumes of air defence missiles could be seen streaking across the sky followed by explosions.

While walking down a major avenue, a witness told AFP he "saw a projectile cut­­t­ing across the sky" abo­ve a mall, saying it left "a yellowish trail of light followed by a trail of smoke. Then, we heard an explosion".

"People were calm; no one was speaking. We were scared and all looking up at the sky," he added, requesting anonymity.

More blasts were heard on Wednesday, AFP journalists in Riyadh reported, as messages were received on phones warning of an "aerial threat" and urging people to take shelter.

The alert was lifted a few minutes later.

A Saudi energy ministry official said a building belonging to Aramco in Dhahran was struck on Tuesday, resulting in a "limited fire" but "no casualties or fatalities".

Dhahran is home to Aramco's headquarters, a vast complex comprising several buildings and residential compounds.

In Riyadh, the civil defence agency said four people — two women, a man and a child — were wounded by debris from two intercepted Houthi cruise missiles and that 15 homes were damaged. The Saudi-led coalition, meanwhile, struck oil sites across western Yemen, with spokesman Turki Al-Malki saying the attacks targeted facilities used to supply the Houthis' effort to "threaten the kingdom, Yemen, the southern Red Sea and waterways".

An AFP correspondent in Sanaa reported an explosion, while a breaking news alert on the Houthi-affiliated Al-Masirah channel said Saudi forces had targeted an oil firm.

Many civilians in the Houthi-controlled Yemeni capital, fearing shortages, have rushed to queue in front of fuel stations.

Several countries have issued travel warnings to their citizens in Saudi Arabia, with France telling its nationals on Tuesday to avoid Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam airports.

In a meeting with the newly appointed secretary general of the Makkah Defence Alliance, retired Lieutenant General Nauman Mahmood, PM Shehbaz was briefed on the strategy to promote "defence and strategic cooperation" under the pact.

Mahmood was appointed as the first secretary general of the defence alliance between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye last month. The agreement — signed on Aug 7 — empowers member states to treat an attack against one of them as an attack against all.

The premier reiterated that the pact was a "historic milestone for peace, unity, and stability in the region" and wished the secretary general well for his new role as Saudi Arabia, which is a signatory to the pact, has faced escalating tensions with Yemen's Houthi rebels in recent days. The PM said that Pakistan "stands shoulder to shoulder" with Saudi Arabia.
output: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Wednesday ko Makkah Defence Alliance — Pakistan, Saudi Arabia aur Turkiye ka defence alliance — ko region mein peace, unity aur stability ke liye historic milestone kaha. Unhone Saudi Arabia ki sovereignty, yani apne faisle khud karne ka haq, territorial integrity, yani borders ki hifazat, aur security ke tahaffuz ke liye Pakistan ke pakke azm ko bhi dohraya. Saudi capital Riyadh mein zordar dhamake hue, aur Houthi attack ne Aramco ke operations centre wale area mein ek building ko target kiya. Saudi energy ministry ke ek official ne kaha ke Tuesday ko Dhahran mein Aramco ki ek building par attack hua, jis se limited fire lagi lekin koi jani nuqsan nahi hua. Riyadh ki civil defence agency ne kaha ke 2 roke gaye Houthi cruise missiles ke malbe se 4 log zakhmi hue aur 15 ghar damage hue. Saudi-led coalition ne western Yemen mein oil sites par attacks kiye, aur spokesman Turki Al-Malki ne kaha ke attacks un facilities ko target kar rahe the jo Houthis ko saman supply karti hain. PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Makkah Defence Alliance ke naye secretary general retired Lieutenant General Nauman Mahmood se mulaqat ki aur defence aur strategic cooperation ki strategy par briefing li. Makkah Defence Alliance ka agreement 7 August ko sign hua tha, aur Nauman Mahmood ko pichhle month Pakistan, Saudi Arabia aur Turkiye ke is defence alliance ka pehla secretary general appoint kiya gaya tha.

ISLAMABAD: In a significant move, PPP, a major ruling coalition partner, and the opposition PTI on Wednesday agreed to maintain contact and cooperate on legislative matters in the parliament.

The agreement was reached when PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari met Leader of the Opposition in the National Assembly Mahmood Khan Achakzai and Leader of the Opposition in the Senate Allama Raja Nasir Abbas at the Parliament House in the NA opposition leader's chamber, PPP said in a post on X.

PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja, Tehreek-i-Tahaffuz Ayeen-i-Pakistan (TTAP) Secretary General Asad Qaiser, Vice Chairman Mustafa Nawaz Khokhar and PTI's Aamir Dogar were also present at the meeting.

PPP leaders Raja Pervez Ashraf, Sherry Rehman, Naveed Qamar and Nadeem Afzal Chan accompanied Bilawal.

The meeting discussed parliamentary affairs and the country's political situation. Bilawal asked the opposition leaders to join parliamentary committees and play an active role, according to the statement.

The opposition leaders said they would decide after consulting the PTI chairman, it added.

The PPP and opposition leaders agreed to increase contact regarding legislation in parliament. Bilawal urged the opposition leaders to play their role in parliament in connection with electoral reforms to ensure transparency in elections.

Referring to the transfer of incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan to the hospital and his treatment following the Supreme Court'sdecision, Bilawal welcomed the development, saying that it was a democratic tradition.

Speaking to the media later in the day, Bilawal termed the meeting a "good start" and said that his party wanted the House to be functional and that the parliamentarians should play their role as mandated by the public.

"If we want our parliament to be functional and its institutions or dignitaries to work, then the opposition should review their decision of boycotting the parliamentary process," he said.

He said that he discussed reviewing the opposition's decision to boycott the parliamentary process in the meeting.

"Whether you are sitting on opposition benches or treasury benches, everyone complains about the electoral process; [so] then it is our responsibility to make reforms in our electoral process," the PPP chairman said.

For this single-point agenda, Bilawal said that the opposition should play its role so that a plan may be formulated for reforms in the electoral process through mutual consensus. "When a party wins elections, it celebrates, and when a party loses elections, it complains; we don't want this."

The PPP chairman further stated that a "communication gap" between his party and the opposition had been lessened after today's meeting and the two sides had initiated discussions on several issues, particularly the "low-hanging fruits" such as electoral reforms.

On being asked about the possibility of the 28th Constitutional Amendment, the PPP chairman said there had been no discussions between the PPP and PML-N on the matter.

Regarding the creation of new provinces, the PPP chairman said that his party would stand by the public's decision. "The PPP will stand with the public's opinion, and whatever decision is taken with mutual understanding, the party will support it. We will never accept anything by force," he stated.

On Tuesday, itemergedthat the PPP had reached out to the opposition alliance to seek its cooperation and was expected to call on Achakzai today.

Sources toldDawnthat the agenda for the cooperation is to work together to strengthen the parliament and parliament's committees.

Talking toDawnon Tuesday, a senior PTI leader had said that it seemed the PPP was trying to "raise its value" through such moves. However, "we will support any party that talks about free and fair elections and stopping rigging through Form 47s", the leader said.

Insiders suggest that while the PPP cannot afford to formally exit the coalition government at the Centre, it could give the government a tough time to show its displeasure over the outcome of theAJK elections.

Over the past couple of weeks, several PPP leaders — including the party chief — had accused the ruling party of 'rigging' and manipulating election results.
output: Wednesday ko PPP aur opposition PTI ne parliament mein qanoon saazi ke maamlat par raabta aur mil kar kaam jari rakhne par ittefaq kiya. Yeh ittefaq PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari ki Parliament House mein National Assembly mein Leader of the Opposition, yani assembly mein opposition ke head, Mahmood Khan Achakzai aur Senate mein Leader of the Opposition Allama Raja Nasir Abbas se mulaqat ke baad hua. PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja, Asad Qaiser, Mustafa Nawaz Khokhar aur Aamir Dogar bhi mulaqat mein mojood the. Mulaqat mein parliamentary affairs aur mulk ki political situation par baat hui aur Bilawal ne opposition leaders se kaha ke woh parliamentary committees mein shamil ho kar active role ada karein. Opposition leaders ne kaha ke woh PTI chairman se mashwara karne ke baad faisla karenge. Bilawal ne opposition leaders se request ki ke woh electoral reforms mein role ada karein taake elections mein transparency ensure ki ja sake. Bilawal ne jailed PTI founder Imran Khan ko hospital shift karne aur Supreme Court ke faisle ke baad unke treatment ko welcome kiya. Bilawal ne kaha ke 28th Constitutional Amendment par PPP aur PML-N ke darmiyan koi baat cheet nahi hui.

JERUSALEM: Colombia on Wednesday officially opened its embassy in Jerusalem, joining a small group of countries including the United States in taking the symbolic step of backing Israeli sovereignty in the contested city.

The vast majority of countries keep their embassies to Israel in Tel Aviv on the grounds that the status of Jerusalem will be settled in a final resolution of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

"This is an important date for the State of Israel. It's also an important date for the city of Jerusalem," Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar said during a ceremony while signing the Colombian embassy's guest book.

Colombia's new hard-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, in July announced that he would move his country's embassy to Jerusalem, a sharp shift from his leftist predecessor. In 2024, president Gustavo Petro severed ties with Israel, one of Colombia's key security partners, over its offensive in the Gaza Strip.

Colombian Foreign Minister Omar Bula said Tuesday's move was "a concrete step toward the restoration of our diplomatic relations; a relationship that should never have been interrupted." "Israel is a strategic partner; it always has been, and from now on it will be so with even greater determination and strength," said Colombian ambassador Tania Gilinski.

"This is the beginning of a golden age in relations between our two countries," Saar said. The Palestinian Authority condemned the move. In a statement, its Foreign Ministry said that "opening an embassy to Israel in occupied Jerusalem constitutes a violation of international legitimacy resolutions…, undermines the international consensus on the legal status of the holy city, and infringes upon the inalienable rights of the Palestinian people." President Donald Trump shattered international consensus in 2018 during his first term by moving the US embassy to Jerusalem, which is home to Israel's parliament, prime minister and most other major governmental institutions.

Since Trump's move, only a handful of small, US-aligned countries have followed suit — Fiji, Guatemala, Honduras, Papua New Guinea, Paraguay and Nauru. Kosovo and Somaliland, which are not member-states of the United Nations, have also opened what they consider their embassies in Jerusalem.

Argentine President Javier Milei, another right-wing Latin American who is an outspoken supporter of Israel, has promised to move his country's embassy to Jerusalem. The status of Jerusalem is one of the thorniest issues in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Former Colombian president Gustavo Petro broke diplomatic relations with Israel in 2024 over its actions in Gaza and had heavily criticised Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Petro also halted coal exports to Israel, closed Colombia's embassy in Tel Aviv and recalled its ambassador, a move Israel said was antisemitic and a reward for Hamas.
output: Colombia ne Wednesday ko Jerusalem mein apna embassy officially khol kar un chand countries mein shamil ho gaya, jismein United States bhi shamil hai, jo Jerusalem mein Israel ki sovereignty yaani us area par poora control ki support karti hain. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar ne ceremony mein Colombia ke embassy ke guest book par sign kiye. Colombia ke naye president Abelardo de la Espriella ne July mein kaha tha ke woh apne mulk ka embassy Jerusalem shift karenge, jabke Colombia ke Foreign Minister Omar Bula ne kaha ke yeh move diplomatic relations restore karne yaani dobara diplomatic contacts banane ki taraf ek concrete step hai. Colombia ki ambassador Tania Gilinski ne kaha ke Israel ek strategic partner yaani ahem long-term ally hai. Doosri taraf Palestinian Authority ne is move ki condemnation ki aur kaha ke occupied Jerusalem mein Israel ka embassy kholna international legal resolutions yaani global level par approved legal decisions ki violation hai aur holy city ki legal status par international consensus yaani duniya ke countries ki shared raay ko weak karta hai. Donald Trump ne 2018 mein US embassy Jerusalem shift kar ke international consensus ko toda tha, aur 2024 mein Colombia ke former president Gustavo Petro ne Gaza Strip mein Israel ki actions par Israel se diplomatic relations khatam kar diye the.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with some knowledge of international relations: briefly explain only the most important concepts.
input:
AT LEAST 30 children, most of them younger than 13, and a teacher have died in Peshawar after the roof of their private schoolcollapsedduring morning classes. Dozens more were injured, some critically.

The victims had arrived at the Al Khair school expecting an ordinary day. Instead, rescue workers spent hours searching through rubble as parents gathered outside. Police say the building was structurally weak and its roof overloaded with additional construction. The owner has been arrested, while an inquiry is under way. These preliminary findings demand scrutiny. So do reports that concerns about the building's condition had previously been raised. In June, 14 children died when the roof of a tuition centrecollapsedin Lahore's Kahna area. Two days later, another schoolroof collapsein Baghbanpura killed an eight-year-old. Three incidents in a few months should be enough to force an examination of the places where Pakistan's children are taught.

Across the country, schools and tuition centres operate in buildings ill-suited to accommodating large numbers of pupils. In crowded urban neighbourhoods, houses are converted into classrooms, sometimes with additional floors, makeshift rooms, and roofs carrying more weight than they were designed to support.

Yet questions about construction quality, structural approvals, and inspections are too often left unanswered until a disaster occurs. The Lahore inquiry found that the Kahna tuition centre operated from an unregistered residential house. Peshawar presents a troubling contrast: according to the KP private schools regulator, Al Khair was registered in March, but technical personnel were absent from its inspection.

If a school can receive registration without a structural assessment, what assurance does that certificate provide? Investigators must establish whether alterations were authorised, who inspected the premises, and whether warnings were received and ignored. They must also examine the regulators' role, not merely the decisions of school management.

The KP authorities' decision to establish district-level committees to inspect private school buildings is welcome, but its value will depend on what follows. The committees have been instructed to examine buildings, identify hazards, and submit reports within three days. Authorities must make the findings public, close premises posing danger, and require independent engineering clearance before they reopen. Similar checks are needed across every province, including at tuition centres and schools operating inside residential properties. Building permission, school registration, and periodic safety certification should be linked, with clear responsibility assigned to qualified inspectors. Owners who make dangerous alterations must face consequences, as must officials found to have neglected their duties. Parents should not have to become structural engineers to judge whether their children are safe at school. After so many deaths, another round of condolences and inquiries without enforcement would be an intolerable response.
output: Peshawar mein Al Khair private school ki chhat subah ki classes ke doran girne se kam az kam 30 bachay aur ek teacher halaak hue. Halaak hone wale bachon mein zyada tar 13 saal se kam umar ke thay, jabke darjanon aur log zakhmi hue aur kuch ki condition critical thi. Police ke mutabiq building structurally weak thi aur chhat par extra construction ka bojh tha. Owner ko arrest kar liya gaya hai aur inquiry chal rahi hai. June mein Lahore ke Kahna area mein ek tuition centre ki chhat girne se 14 bachay halaak hue, aur do din baad Baghbanpura mein ek school ki chhat girne se 8 saal ka bacha halaak hua. KP private schools regulator, yaani woh body jo private schools ko monitor karti hai, ke mutabiq Al Khair ki registration March mein hui thi, lekin is ke inspection mein technical staff maujood nahi tha. KP authorities ne private school buildings ke inspection ke liye district-level committees banayi hain, jinhein 3 din mein report dene ki hidayat di gayi hai. Authorities ko findings public karni, dangerous buildings band karne, aur dobara kholne se pehle independent engineering clearance, yaani expert engineers se written approval, mandatory karne ki zaroorat hai.

چالیس روزہ جنگ نے ایران کی حکومت کی قیادت کی اعلیٰ ترین سطحوں کو شدید متاثر کیا ہے۔ علی خامنہ ای اور متعدد سینیئر فوجی کمانڈر اور سیاسی شخصیات ہلاک ہو چکی ہیں۔ اب بہت سے اعلیٰ فوجی رہنماؤں کی عدم موجودگی میں محسن رضائی ایک بار پھر پس منظر سے نکل کر اقتدار کے مرکز میں آ گئے ہیں۔

ان دنوں وہ ٹیلی ویژن پر نظر آتے ہیں، غیر ملکی عہدیداروں سے ملاقاتیں کرتے ہیں، تقریباً ہر روز امریکہ کے لیے نئی سرخ لکیریں کھینچتے ہیں اور شرائط بیان کرتے ہیں، جوہری بم کے بارے میں گفتگو کرتے ہیں اور عوام سے مطالبہ کرتے ہیں کہ وہ 'ہر گھر' کو 'اقتصادی جنگ میں ایک لانچ پیڈ' میں تبدیل کر دیں۔

پاسدارانِ انقلاب کے کمانڈر کے طور پر محسن رضائی کی مدتِ ملازمت ختم ہونے اور نئی نسل کے کمانڈروں کے ابھرنے کے بعد سکیورٹی اور فوجی امور میں ان کی براہِ راست موجودگی بتدریج کم ہوتی گئی۔ تاہم وہ کئی برسوں تک مجمع تشخیصِ مصلحتِ نظام کے سیکرٹری کے طور پر خدمات انجام دیتے رہے۔

12 روزہ اور 40 روزہ جنگوں میں متعدد سینیئر کمانڈروں کی ہلاکت کے بعد رضائی دوبارہ اقتدار کے مرکز میں آ گئے ہیں۔ انھیں پہلے مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کا نمائندہ مقرر کیا گیا اور بعد میں سپریم نیشنل سکیورٹی کونسل کا سیکریٹری بنایا گیا۔

ان تقرریوں، خصوصاً نئے رہنما کے نمائندے کے طور پر ان کی نامزدگی، کو مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے ان پر خصوصی اعتماد اور سکیورٹی و فوجی فیصلہ سازی میں رضائی کے کردار کی بحالی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔

محسن رضائی چار صدارتی انتخابات میں حصہ لے چکے ہیں اور ہمیشہ ناکام رہے تھے اور ایک موقع پر تو مسترد شدہ ووٹوں کی تعداد بھی ان کے حاصل شدہ ووٹوں سے زیادہ تھی۔ تاہم اب وہ ایک ایسی پوزیشن میں ہیں جہاں وہ ملک کے بڑے فیصلوں پر اثر انداز ہو سکتے ہیں۔

ایران کا سرکاری نشریاتی ادارہ اب اس ٹو سٹار جنرل کو ایران کا 'فیلڈ مارشل' قرار دیتا ہے، جو پانچ ستاروں والے جنرل کے مساوی رتبہ سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

وہ اس وقت سپریم نیشنل سکیورٹی کونسل کے سیکرٹری کے عہدے پر فائز ہیں، جو عدلیہ کے سربراہ کے بقول 'قومی مفادات کے تحفظ اور سرحد پار خطرات کا مقابلہ کرنے والا صفِ اول کا ادارہ' ہے۔

رضائی اس اہم ترین ادارے کی قیادت کر رہے ہیں، جو حکومت کی تینوں شاخوں کے فیصلوں پر اثر انداز ہو سکتا ہے، کونسل میں رہبر کی ہدایات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے اور کونسل کے فیصلوں کو مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے مطالبات اور ترجیحات کے مطابق بنانے میں کردار ادا کر سکتا ہے۔

مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے 'فوجی مشیر' مقرر کیے جانے کے بعد سے محسن رضائی کے بیانات کو میڈیا میں خاص اہمیت حاصل ہو گئی ہے اور حکومتی ڈھانچے میں ان کے کردار کی نئی تعریف کے بعد ملکی اور بین الاقوامی حلقوں میں ان کے بیانات کا حوالہ دیا جانے لگا ہے۔

نئے اقتدار کے ڈھانچے میں ان کے منصب کی اہمیت سمجھنے کے لیے مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے انتخاب اور محسن رضائی کی تقرری کے درمیان موجود فاصلے پر توجہ دینا ضروری ہے۔

گذشتہ برس 8 مارچ کو مجلسِ خبرگان نے اعلان کیا تھا کہ مجتبیٰ خامنہ ایران کے اگلے رہنما ہوں گے۔

11 مارچ کو ایرانی عوام کے لیے مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے نام سے منسوب پہلا تحریری پیغام شائع ہوا اور تین دن بعد 15 مارچ کو ایرانی میڈیا نے مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے حوالے سے کہا کہ علی خامنہ ای کی جانب سے جاری کیے گئے احکامات اور اختیارات اب بھی مؤثر ہیں اور 'فی الحال ان میں سے کسی کی تجدید کی ضرورت نہیں ہے۔'

اسی دوران روزنامہ ہمشہری نے اعلان کیا کہ محسن رضائی کو 'کمانڈر اِن چیف کا فوجی مشیر' مقرر کیا گیا ہے۔

دوسرے لفظوں میں مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے حوالے سے ایرانی میڈیا میں شائع ہونے والا پہلا بیان محسن رضائی کے نام سے جاری کیا گیا۔

اگرچہ اس حکم نامے کا متن سرکاری طور پر شائع نہیں کیا گیا، تاہم یہ تاثر پیدا ہوا کہ محسن رضائی ایران کے نئے رہنما کے قریبی اور قابلِ اعتماد افراد میں شامل ہیں۔

اس کے بعد سے میڈیا، بالخصوص ایران کے سرکاری نشریاتی ادارے نے، مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے 'فوجی مشیر' محسن رضائی پر زیادہ توجہ دینا شروع کر دی اور وہ مسلسل خبروں میں رہے ہیں۔

فوجی مشیر کے طور پر تقرری اور 'سپریم نیشنل سکیورٹی کونسل' میں مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے نمائندے کے طور پر تعارف کے درمیانی عرصے میں محسن رضائی نے یہ ظاہر کیا کہ وہ اسلام آباد مذاکرات اور ایران و امریکہ کے درمیان مفاہمتی یادداشت کے مخالف ہیں اور اس معاملے میں ان کا مؤقف مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای کے خیالات کے قریب ہے۔

جس طرح مجتبیٰ خامنہ ای ایران اور امریکہ کے درمیان تنازع کے خاتمے کے لیے 'جنگ بندی' کی اصطلاح استعمال نہیں کرتے اور اسے 'میدانِ جنگ میں خاموشی کا دور' قرار دیتے ہیں۔ اسی طرح رضائی نے بھی زور دے کر کہا: 'میں اسے جنگ بندی تسلیم نہیں کرتا۔ یہ ایک فوجی خاموشی ہے۔'

محسن رضائی، جو مسلح افواج کے سپریم کمانڈر کے فوجی مشیر کے طور پر فوجی لباس میں ملبوس تھے، نے امریکہ کو بار بار خبردار کرتے ہوئے کہا 'ہمارے بھائیوں نے غالباً اپنے لانچرز کا رُخ ابراہام لنکن اور تمام امریکی جہازوں کی طرف کر دیا ہے اور ہم ان سب کو غرق کر دیں گے۔'

محسن رضائی نے سی این این کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں کہا: 'اگر جنگ جاری رہی اور بحری ناکہ بندی ختم نہ کی گئی تو ہم جنگ کا دائرہ بحرِ ہند، آبنائے باب المندب، بحیرۂ احمر اور بحیرۂ روم تک وسعت دے دیں گے۔'
output: 40-day war ne Iran ki government ki leadership ke highest levels ko bohat buri tarah mutasir kiya hai. Ali Khamenei aur kai senior military commanders aur political figures halaak ho chuke hain. Bohat se top military leaders ke na hone ki wajah se, Mohsen Rezaei ek baar phir power ke center mein aa gaye hain. Mohsen Rezaei ko pehle Mojtaba Khamenei ka representative appoint kiya gaya aur baad mein Supreme National Security Council, yani Iran ki highest security decision-making council, ka secretary banaya gaya. Mohsen Rezaei 4 presidential elections mein hissa le chuke hain aur hamesha haar gaye the. Iran ka official broadcaster Mohsen Rezaei ko Iran ka "field marshal" kehta hai. 11 March ko Iranian logon ke liye Mojtaba Khamenei ke naam se mansoob pehla written message publish hua. Mohsen Rezaei ne CNN ko kaha ke naval blockade, yani samundari raaston ki rok, khatam na hone par war Indian Ocean, Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, Red Sea aur Mediterranean Sea tak phail jayegi.

input:
امریکہ میں گذشتہ تقریباً ایک ہفتے کے دوران کم از کم تین افغان شہریوں کو پُرتشدد کارروائیوں میں ملوث ہونے کے الزام میں گرفتار کیا جا چُکا ہے۔

امریکہ میں ان گرفتار ہونے والے تین افغان شہریوں میں رحمان اللہ، جان شاہ صافی اور محمد داؤد الوکزئی شامل ہیں۔

منگل کے روز امریکی محکمہ ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کی جانب سے جاری ہونے والے ایک بیان میں کہا گیا ہے کہ انھوں نے جان شاہ صافی نامی ایک افغان شہری کو گرفتار کیا ہے جن کے بارے میں کہا جاتا ہے کہ اُنھوں نے عراق اور شام کی دولتِ اسلامیہ کی ایک شاخ خراسان کی مدد کی اور اس کے ساتھ ساتھ انھوں نے اپنے والد کو بھی ہتھیار فراہم کیے جو افغانستان میں ایک مسلح گروہ کے کمانڈر ہیں۔

ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کی سیکریٹری کرسٹین نُوم کے مطابق جان شاہ صافی کو بدھ کے روز ریاست ورجینیا کے علاقے وینزبورو میں امریکی امیگریشن اینڈ کسٹمز انفورسمنٹ ایجنسی کی ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی انویسٹی گیشنز ڈویژن کے اہلکاروں نے گرفتار کیا۔

ایجنسی کا کہنا ہے کہ صافی امریکہ میں غیر قانونی طور پر داخل ہونے والے 'دہشت گرد' ہیں، جو 8 ستمبر 2021 کو بائیڈن انتظامیہ کے 'آپریشن ویلکم فرینڈز' پروگرام کے تحت امریکہ پہنچے تھے۔ اس کے بعد انھوں نے عارضی تحفظ کے لیے درخواست دی تھی، مگر یہ درخواست اس وقت منسوخ ہو گئی جب سیکریٹری کرسٹین نُوم نے افغان شہریوں کے لیے عارضی تحفظ کا پروگرام ختم کر دیا۔

ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کی سیکریٹری کرسٹین نُوم نے کہا کہ 'آج ہمارے بہادر افسران نے جان شاہ صافی کو گرفتار کیا، جو ایک ایسا دہشت گرد ہے جس نے نام نہاد دولتِ اسلامیہ کو مدد فراہم کی۔ یہ 'دہشت گرد' ہمارے دارالحکومت سے چند میل کے فاصلے پر گرفتار ہوا، جہاں چند روز قبل ایک اور افغان 'دہشت گرد' نے ہمارے بہادر نیشنل گارڈز کے اہلکاروں سارہ بیکستروم اور اینڈریو وولف کو گولی ماری تھی۔'

سیکریٹری کرسٹین نُوم کے مطابق 'بائیڈن انتظامیہ نے امریکی تاریخ کے بدترین قومی سلامتی کے بحرانوں میں سے ایک کو جنم دیا۔ بائیڈن نے تقریباً ایک لاکھ 90 ہزار ایسے افغان شہریوں کو مُلک میں آنے کی اجازت دی کہ جن کے پاس قانونی تقاضے پورے کرنے کے لیے مکمل دستاویزات نہیں تھے۔ان افغان شہریوں کی شناخت اس وقت سامنے آئی کہ جب وہ امریکی سرزمین پر پہنچ چکے تھے۔'

انھوں نے اپنے بیان میں مزید کہا کہ 'صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ 20 جنوری سے اس بحران سے نمٹنے کے لیے اقدامات پر کام کر رہے ہیں تاکہ مُلک سے اس مسئلے کو ختم کیا جا سکے۔'

جان شاہ صافی سے متعلق خبریں سامنے آنے کے بعد سابق افغان کمانڈرز اور دیگر حلقوں کی جانب سے اس معاملے پر تنقید بھی دیکھنے میں آ رہی ہے۔

ماضی میں افغانستان کی خفیہ ایجنسی 'این ڈی ایس' میں بطور ڈائریکٹر تعینات رہنے والے رحمت اللہ نبیل نے سوشل میڈیا سائیٹ 'ایکس' پر لکھا کہ 'یہ صورتحال واضح طور پر ظاہر کرتی ہے کہ امریکی انٹیلیجنس ایجنسیاں سیاسی مقابلے سے بہت زیادہ متاثر ہو گئی ہیں اور انھوں نے اپنی پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیت پر فوکس کو کھو دیا ہے۔ ایسے ماحول میں صافی جیسے لوگ نمایاں نظر آتے ہیں۔ وہ افغانستان کی نیشنل ڈائریکٹوریٹ آف سکیورٹی (این ڈی ایس) کے سب سے سرگرم اور مؤثر افسران میں شمار ہوتے تھے۔ دہشت گردی کے خلاف کام، انتہا پسندوں کے نیٹ ورکس کی نشاندہی اور انٹیلیجنس ذرائع کو سنبھالنے میں ان کی خدمات اُن کی پہچان کا باعث بنیں۔'

انھوں نے مزید لکھا کہ 'صافی کا اثر و رسوخ جزوی طور پر اُن کے والد حاجی جنداد خان صافی کی میراث سے آیا، جو سابق سوویت یونین کے خلاف جہاد کے دوران ایک کمانڈر تھے جو طالبان اور داعش کے سخت مخالف تھے۔ طالبان کے پہلے دورِ حکومت میں، جنداد خان نے احمد شاہ مسعود کے ساتھ مل کر لڑائی کی، جس نے ان کے خاندان کو مقامی برادریوں میں دیرپا احترام، اعتماد اور رسائی دلائی۔'
output: US mein pichhle taqreeban ek hafte ke dauran kam az kam 3 Afghan citizens ko violent karwaiyon mein mulawis hone ke ilzaam mein giraftar kiya gaya, jin mein Rahmanullah, Jan Shah Safi aur Mohammad Daud Alokozai shamil hain. Tuesday ko Homeland Security ke statement mein kaha gaya ke Jan Shah Safi ne Islamic State of Iraq and Syria ke Khorasan branch ki madad ki aur apne father ko hathiyar faraham kiye. Kristi Noem ke mutabiq Safi ko Wednesday ko Virginia ke Waynesboro area mein U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency ke officers ne giraftar kiya. Safi 8 September 2021 ko Biden administration ke 'Operation Welcome Friends' program ke tehat US pohnche the, aur un ki temporary protection, yani kuch arse ke liye US mein rehne ki legal ijazat, ki application baad mein cancel ho gayi. Kristi Noem ne kaha ke President Donald Trump 20 January se is crisis se deal karne ke liye measures par kaam kar rahe hain. Jan Shah Safi ki giraftari ki khabron ke baad former Afghan commanders aur doosre halqon ne tanqeed ki. Rahmatullah Nabil ne kaha ke Safi Afghanistan ke National Directorate of Security (NDS), yani Afghan intelligence agency, ke sab se active aur effective officers mein shumar hote the.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with some knowledge of international relations: briefly explain only the most important concepts.
input:
ISLAMABAD: The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has extended electronic production monitoring to the leather, paper and paperboard sectors, authorising four private vendors to install and operate camera-based monitoring systems across industrial sectors.

The move is part of the FBR's efforts to strengthen sales tax monitoring and curb tax evasion by obtaining production data directly from manufacturing units rather than relying solely on figures declared by registered manufacturers. The monitoring system is already operating in several industries.

The expansion brought additional manufacturing sectors into a system through which the tax authority can directly observe production activity and maintain records of factory operations, reducing its dependence on production figures declared by registered manufacturers.

The FBR issued SRO 1751 of 2026 on Wednesday to notify that production by registered manufacturers of leather and paper and paperboard would be electronically monitored under Chapter XIV BA of the Sales Tax Rules 2006.

In a separate authorisation, the FBR approved four vendors to supply, install, operate and maintain production-monitoring equipment across five sectors — packaged tea, household electronics, paper and paperboard, edible oil and ghee, and leather.

Obsidian Technologies will monitor textile spinning, while Tollink Pakistan covers aerated beverages and bottled water. ISSM Labelling Solutions monitors textile spinning, tiles, packaged milk, packaged juices and bottled water, while Authentik covers aerated beverages, packaged milk, packaged juices and bottled water.

Under the new arrangement, IP cameras and Network Video Recorders (NVRs) will be installed at production lines. The cameras will continuously capture production activity in real time, while the NVRs will retain recordings for at least two months.

The vendors will be responsible for procuring, installing, operating, maintaining and repairing the equipment. The authorisation is limited to IP cameras and NVRs, barring vendors from supplying or charging manufacturers for any other equipment or software.

All footage and recordings will remain the property of the FBR and will be treated as confidential, with sharing prohibited except as directed by the Board.

The FBR has introduced an online facility allowing steel melters and re-rollers to declare electricity consumption to calculate their sales tax liability when power distribution companies fail to report supplies or submit returns late.

Annex K of the sales tax return is mandatory for steel melters, re-rollers, and composite units to calculate sales tax liability under the Thirteenth Schedule of the Sales Tax Act 1990. The automated system normally obtains electricity consumption data after distribution companies file Annex C of their returns.

However, the FBR said taxpayers were facing difficulties when distribution companies either did not declare electricity supplied to them or filed their returns late, preventing the required consumption data from being automatically reflected in Annex K.
output: FBR ne leather, paper aur paperboard sectors mein production monitoring ke electronic system ko extend kar diya hai, aur 4 private vendors ko camera-based monitoring systems install aur operate karne ki ijazat di hai. FBR ne Wednesday ko SRO 1751 of 2026 issue kiya, jis ke tehat leather aur paper aur paperboard ke registered manufacturers ki production electronically monitor hogi, aur yeh monitoring Sales Tax Rules 2006 ke Chapter XIV BA ke under hogi. FBR ne 5 sectors yaani packaged tea, household electronics, paper aur paperboard, edible oil aur ghee, aur leather ke liye 4 vendors ki approval di hai. Production lines par IP cameras aur Network Video Recorders (NVRs) install kiye jayenge, aur NVRs kam az kam 2 months ki recording rakhenge. Is ke ilawa FBR ne steel melters aur re-rollers ke liye online facility shuru ki hai taake woh electricity consumption khud declare kar ke sales tax liability calculate kar saken. Annex K of the sales tax return mein steel melters, re-rollers aur composite units, yaani ek hi registration mein kai businesses, ke liye mandatory hai, aur agar distribution companies electricity supply declare na karein ya returns late file karein to taxpayers ko mushkil hoti hai.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with some knowledge of international relations: briefly explain only the most important concepts.
input:
BUCHAREST: Rescuers searched on Thursday for seven missing sailors after drones struck two chemical tankers near Romania's Black Sea coast, setting them ablaze and raising fresh security concerns along a vital shipping route used by Ukraine.

Romanian President Nicusor Dan said the two ships had been struck by drones but declined to say whether Russia was responsible, while a Nato military source said the drones came from Russia. "The drones that caused the fires on board two tankers inside Romanian territorial waters were of Russian origin," the Nato source said.

The two vessels were anchored near the mouth of the Sulina canal leading into the Danube River, a major export route used by Ukraine as Russia has repeatedly attacked Ukraine's Black Sea ports. One was inside Romanian territorial waters and the other just outside. The missing crew were among 12 sailors aboard the San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader, which was hit 13 nautical miles southeast of the Sulina canal, one mile outside Romanian waters. Five crew members were rescued, Romanian officials said.

The second vessel, the Comoros-flagged chemical and oil tanker Yara J, caught fire after being struck 8-10 miles southeast of Sulina inside Romanian waters late on Wednesday. All crew were safe.

The attacks are the latest in a series of strikes on commercial shipping in the western Black Sea. At least five other cargo vessels have been hit near the coasts of Romania and neighbouring Nato member Bulgaria over the past 10 days, with at least 23 sailors reported missing or dead. Those attacks occurred outside Nato territorial waters.
output: Romania ke Black Sea coast ke qareeb drone strikes ke baad rescue workers Thursday ko 7 missing sailors ki talash kar rahe thay. In strikes mein 2 chemical tankers ko target banaya gaya aur un mein aag lag gayi. Romania ke President Nicusor Dan ne kaha ke dono ships par drone attacks hue, lekin unhon ne yeh nahi bataya ke Russia iska responsible hai ya nahi; however, Nato ke ek military source ne kaha ke drones Russia se aaye thay. Dono ships Sulina canal ke mouth ke qareeb anchored thay, jo Danube River mein jata hai aur Ukraine ke liye ek major export route hai. San Marino-flagged tanker Wine Trader par 12 sailors on board thay aur missing crew unhi mein shamil thay; yeh ship Sulina canal se 13 nautical miles southeast mein, Romania ke territorial waters, yani coast se lage samundar ke us hisse, se 1 mile bahar target bana, aur Romania ke officials ne kaha ke 5 crew members ko bacha liya gaya. Comoros-flagged chemical aur oil tanker Yara J Wednesday late Sulina se 8-10 miles southeast mein Romania ke territorial waters ke andar target banne ke baad aag lag gayi, aur iska tamam crew safe tha. Pichhle 10 dinon mein Romania aur Nato ke member neighbouring Bulgaria ke coasts ke qareeb kam az kam 5 other cargo vessels target bane, aur kam az kam 23 sailors missing ya dead bataye gaye.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with some knowledge of international relations: briefly explain only the most important concepts.
input:
JAKARTA: Four people died on Indonesia's Java island fighting the blazes that have sent toxic smoke across southeast Asia, closed schools and fuelled a surge of respiratory complaints, authorities said on Friday.

The four lost their lives in East Java's Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park.

Two others suffered serious burns and were receiving further medical treatment.

"This incident serves as a reminder that forest and land fire extinguishing is a high-risk operation," it said, adding that personnel safety remained a primary concern.

The impact of the months-long fires has also prompted Singapore's leader to vow legal action against any companies responsible for the blazes that have made regional air quality among the world's worst.

Singapore again topped IQAir's live ranking of the world's most polluted major cities on Friday, with Kuala Lumpur second and Jakarta eighth.

"Where warranted, we will take action under Singapore's Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, and also explore joint action with other countries," said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.

Authorities said Singapore had put on notice seven Indonesian firms whose "activities caused or contributed to unhealthy haze levels".

Legal experts have cautioned that pursuing companies linked to the smoke is challenging, with investigations reliant on cooperation from foreign authorities.

Singapore has no plantations or forests of its own, but several companies with concessions in Indonesia are reportedly based in the city state.

Indonesia's forestry department said there was a significant jump in hotspots in several areas in six "priority provinces" where 615 hotspots were detected.

A hotspot is a location where a satellite detects an unusually high temperature, indicating a potential fire or other strong heat source.

Singapore's investigations into four Indonesian companies over their alleged role in the 2015 haze crisis remain open, a case that strained relations with Jakarta at the time.

An official at Indonesia's national police investigations agency on Wednesday said it was probing companies responsible for the fires, but did not give specific names.

Indonesia experiences wildfires regularly during its dry season, but this year the blazes have been especially severe because a strong El Nino has brought drought.

While drought contributes to the fires, experts say deforestation and drying of peatlands has damaged previously fire-resistant landscapes.

"We cannot control the weather or the winds, nor can we directly control what happens beyond our borders," said Singapore leader Wong.

"But we will do everything we can to protect Singaporeans, while working with our neighbours to address the underlying causes of the haze."
output: Indonesia ke island Java par aag bujhane ke doran 4 log halaak ho gaye; yeh charon East Java ke Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park mein mare gaye, jabke 2 aur shadeed jal gaye aur unka mazeed ilaaj jari hai. Singapore ke Prime Minister Lawrence Wong ne kaha ke zaroorat parne par Transboundary Haze Pollution Act, yaani Singapore ka qanoon jo cross-border haze pollution se deal karta hai, ke under action liya jayega. Friday ko IQAir ki ranking mein Singapore pehle, Kuala Lumpur doosre aur Jakarta aathwen number par raha. Singapore ne 7 Indonesian companies ko notices jari kiye jin ki activities se haze ki unhealthy levels paida huin, aur Indonesia ke forestry department ne 6 priority provinces mein 615 hotspots, yaani aag ke aise spots jahan se dhuan uthta hai, identify kiye. Singapore ki 4 Indonesian companies ke khilaf 2015 ke haze crisis se related investigations ab bhi open hain.

Russian presidential envoy for Afghanistan Zamir Kabulov said Moscow regretted that the participants could not agree on the final document.

"When drafting the final joint statement, we encountered one problem, that problem was that our Afghan and Pakistani colleagues didn't see eye to eye," he said.

The Moscow meeting brought together special envoys and senior officials from Afghanistan, China, India, Iran, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Russia, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan, with Belarus and Egypt attending as guests. The format dates back to 2016 -17 and has emerged as one of the main regional diplomatic tracks on Afghanistan.

The failure to agree on a joint statement underscored how the worsening Pakistan-Afghanistan dispute is now complicating wider regional efforts to build consensus on Afghanistan.

The tense relations between Islamabad and Kabul were among the key issues discussed at the meeting, with the dispute over terrorism and counterterrorism language ultimately preventing the adoption of the joint document.

Mr Kabulov said the Afghan side objected to references that placed Afghanistan in a terrorist context.

Pakistan's special envoy for Afghanistan, Moha­mmad Sadiq, told the meeting that Islamabad wanted peace and stability in the region and had pursued political and diplomatic engagement with the Taliban leadership to address terrorism emanating from Afghan soil.

"Pakistan desires peace and stability in the region and has remained patiently engaged in political and diplomatic efforts aimed at addressing the menace of terrorism emanating from Afghan soil. However, it is unfortunate that Pakistan's numerous goodwill gestures and highly responsible appr­oach were misconstrued, resulting in increased terrorist attacks from Afghan soil, with the active support and backing of the Taliban Regime," he said.

Afghan Taliban Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi, meanwhile, criticised Pakistan's statements and actions towards Afghanistan and Afghans, accusing Islamabad of using military pressure, refugees, students and transit routes as instruments of leverage.

At the same time, he insisted that the problems affecting relations bet­ween the two neighbours could be resolved through dialogue and diplomacy.

Russia offered to help de-escalate the dispute, although Kabulov stressed that resolving bilateral disputes was not the purpose of the Moscow Format.

"Russia is ready to assist in ending this conflict in any possible, permissible way either on its own or in partnership with our other partners provided that both sides make such a request. We are ready to provide the maximum possible assistance," he said.
output: Russia ke presidential envoy for Afghanistan Zamir Kabulov ne kaha ke Moscow ko afsos hai ke participants final document par agree nahi kar sake, kyunke Afghan aur Pakistani colleagues ki opinion ek nahi thi. Moscow meeting, jo 2016-17 se chalne wale Moscow Format yaani Afghanistan par talks ke ek consultative process ka hissa hai, mein Afghanistan, China, India, Iran, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Pakistan, Russia, Tajikistan aur Uzbekistan ke special envoys aur senior officials shamil hue, jabke Belarus aur Egypt guests the. Is meeting mein Islamabad aur Kabul ke tense relations key issues mein shamil the, aur terrorism aur counterterrorism ki language par dispute ne joint document adopt karne ko rok diya. Kabulov ne kaha ke Afghan side ne un references par objection kiya jo Afghanistan ko terrorism ke context mein rakhte the. Pakistan ke special envoy for Afghanistan Mohammad Sadiq ne kaha ke Islamabad region mein peace aur stability chahta hai aur Afghan soil se aane wali terrorism se deal karne ke liye Taliban leadership se political aur diplomatic engagement rakha. Afghan Taliban ke Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi ne Pakistan ke statements aur Afghanistan aur Afghans ke baare mein actions par criticism ki aur Islamabad par ilzaam lagaya ke woh military pressure, refugees, students aur transit routes ko pressure ke tor par use kar raha hai. Muttaqi ne kaha ke dono neighbours ke relations ke issues dialogue aur diplomacy se solve ho sakte hain. Russia ne dispute ko de-escalate karne mein help ki offer ki, lekin Kabulov ne stress kiya ke bilateral disputes yaani sirf dono sides ke beech ke jhagron ka hal Moscow Format ka maqsad nahi aur Russia dono sides ki request par help ke liye tayyar hai.

input:
ISLAMABAD: Pakistan and Russia agreed on Wednesday to finalise an extradition treaty and an agreement on the exchange of criminals, while holding high-level talks to expand bilateral trade, economic and defence cooperation during the first-ever visit by a Russian interior minister to Islamabad.

The law enforcement understandings were reached during a meeting between Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Kolokoltsev, who arrived Monday on a four-day visit.

Following delegation-level talks, the two sides pledged to sign a memorandum of understanding on cooperation in preventing organised crime and exchanging information, an accord witnessed by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.

Mr Naqvi said the proposed memorandum on preventing organised crime would be an important milestone in cooperation between the two countries.

Both sides also decided to ensure the early implementation of a readmission agreement and agreed to enhance cooperation between Pakis­tan's Anti-Narcotics Force and relevant Russian institutions, as well as between the National Police Academy and the Russian Police Academy, to prevent cybercrime.

Mr Kolokoltsev said joint measures were essential for the prevention of all organised crime, including terrorism, drug smuggling and illegal migration, noting that Russia had brought a 33 per cent reduction in cybercrime through effective measures.

They also discussed sending skilled manpower from Pakistan to Russia, easing the visa regime for tourists and the business community to increase people-to-people contact, and increasing the number of Pakistani students in Russia beyond the current 1,300.
output: Pakistan aur Russia ne Wednesday ko extradition treaty, yani wanted criminals ki wapsi ka agreement, aur criminals ke exchange ke agreement ko final shape dene par ittefaq kiya. Yeh ittefaq Russian interior minister ke Islamabad ke pehle visit ke doran hua. Vladimir Kolokoltsev Monday ko 4-day visit par pohnche the aur Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi se mulaqat ki. Dono sides ne organized crime ko rokne aur information ke exchange par memorandum of understanding par sign karne ka azm kiya, jiski Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ne gawahi di. Dono ne readmission agreement, yani ek mulk ka doosre mulk ke citizens ko wapas lene ka agreement, jald implement karne ka faisla kiya. Dono ne cybercrime rokne ke liye Anti-Narcotics Force aur relevant Russian institutions, aur National Police Academy aur Russian Police Academy ke darmiyan cooperation barhane ka faisla kiya. Vladimir Kolokoltsev ne kaha ke Russia ne effective measures se cybercrime mein 33 percent kami ki. Dono ne Pakistan se Russia ko skilled manpower bhejne, visa regime mein narmi aur Russia mein Pakistani students ki tadaad 1,300 se barhane par baat ki.

خیال رہے کہ جواد سعید کی اہلیہ شازیہ جواد نے اپنے شوہر کے کورٹ مارشل کی تفصیلات کے حصول کے لیے پہلے اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ اور پھر لاہور ہائیکورٹ سے رجوع کیا۔ سابق ایئر مارشل جواد سعید کے خلاف کسی بھی زیرِ التوا معاملے پر لاہور ہائیکورٹ کی جانب سے وفاقی حکومت کو فیصلہ کرنے کے لیے دی گئی ڈیڈ لائن بھی اب ختم ہو گئی ہے لیکن اس پر کوئی پیش رفت دکھائی نہیں دی ہے۔

لاہور ہائیکورٹ کے راولپنڈی بینچ نے 22 اکتوبر 2025 کو جواد سعید کی اہلیہ شازیہ جواد کی ایک درخواست پر وفاقی حکومت کو حکم دیا تھا کہ اگر اُن کے پاس پاکستانی فضائیہ کے سابق ایئر مارشل کے حوالے سے کوئی معاملہ زیر التوا ہے تو وہ قانون کے مطابق ایک ماہ کے اندر اس پر فیصلہ کرے۔

جواد سعید کی حراست کے بعد شازیہ جواد نےاسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ میں بھی پاکستانی فضائیہ کی جانب سے اپنے شوہر کو مبینہ طور پر حبسِ بے جا میں رکھنے کے حوالے سے درخواست بھی دائر کی تھی۔

اس معاملے میں اپریل 2025 میں پاکستانی فضائیہ کی جانب سے اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ کو آگاہ کیا گیا تھا کہ سابق ایئر مارشل جواد سعید کو فیلڈ جنرل کورٹ مارشل کی کارروائی کے نتیجے میں 14 سال قید کی سزا سنائی گئی تاہم اس سزا کے خلاف اپیل کے نتیجے میں سزا میں دس سال کی کمی کر دی گئی تھی۔

اسلام آباد ہائیکورٹ میں جواد سعید کے کورٹ مارشل کے بارے میں معلومات کی فراہمی کے بعد عدالت کی جانب سے شازیہ جواد کی درخواست کو خارج کر دیا گیا تھا۔ اس درخواست کے اخراج اور پھر فیصلے پر نظرِثانی کی درخواست واپس لیے جانے کے بعد رواں برس جواد سعید کی اہلیہ کی جانب سے وزارتِ دفاع میں ایک اور درخواست دی گئی جس میں استدعا کی گئی کہ اُن کے شوہر کے خلاف فیلڈ جنرل کورٹ مارشل کی کارروائی کو 'غیر قانونی' اور 'غیر منصفانہ' قرار دیتے ہوئے کالعدم قرار دیا جائے۔

حکومت کی جانب سے اس درخواست پر کوئی کارروائی نہ کیے جانے پر شازیہ جواد نے اکتوبر 2025 میں لاہور ہائیکورٹ سے رجوع کیا اور عدالت سے استدعا کی تھی کہ وہ وفاقی حکومت کو اُن کی زیر التوا درخواست پر جلد از جلد فیصلہ کرنے کا حکم دے۔
output: Shazia Jawad ne apne shohar Jawad Saeed ke court-martial, yani military court ki karwai, ki details lene ke liye pehle Islamabad High Court aur phir Lahore High Court se rabta kiya. Lahore High Court ke Rawalpindi bench ne 22 October 2025 ko federal government ko hukm diya tha ke 1 month ke andar faisla kare, lekin former Air Marshal Jawad Saeed ke against pending matter par di gayi deadline khatam ho gayi aur koi progress nazar nahi aayi. April 2025 mein Pakistan Air Force ne Islamabad High Court ko bataya tha ke Jawad Saeed ko Field General Court Martial, yani military law ke tehat ek special court, mein 14 years qaid ki saza sunayi gayi, aur appeal ke nateeje mein saza mein 10 years ki kami kar di gayi. Islamabad High Court ne Shazia Jawad ki petition dismiss kar di thi, jis ke baad Shazia Jawad ne Ministry of Defence mein request di ke Field General Court Martial ki karwai ko illegal aur unfair qarar de kar void kar diya jaye. Jab government ne koi action nahi liya, Shazia Jawad ne October 2025 mein Lahore High Court se rabta kiya.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with some knowledge of international relations: briefly explain only the most important concepts.
input:
UNITED NATIONS: More than 340 children have been reportedly killed and hundreds more injured in Gaza sincea ceasefire between Hamas and Israelwas announced, the UN Children's Fund (Unicef) said on Friday, warning that children continue to face grave risks despite the truce.

"For families mourning theloss of their children, those terrible statistics do not equate with a ceasefire," Unicef spokesperson Ricardo Pires told reporters in Geneva.

The Unicef noted that five boys and two girls had been reported killed in Gaza over the preceding two weeks, while at least 33 children were seriously injured in air strikes, drone strikes and gunfire across the territory. Two other boys died from injuries sustained earlier, Pires said.

Around 800,000 children remain displaced, most living in tents or damaged buildings, while an estimated 60,000 have lost one or both parents during the war or since the ceasefire, according to the Unicef.

Nearly every child needs some form of mental health support to recover from the effects of the conflict.

The agency called on the parties to the conflict to uphold the ceasefire, comply with UN Security Council Resolution 2803 and meet their obligations under international humanitarian law.

"Above all, we need to listen to thevoices of childrenin Gaza," the Unicef said, stressing that recovery meant more than survival. Children needed to return to school, spend time with friends and family, have dignified shelter, play safely and receive healthcare, the agency said.

"Gaza's children have suffered far too much, for far too long," it added.

The agency stressed the need to maintain an uninterrupted flow of humanitarian and commercial supplies into Gaza, following reports that private traders had halted cooperation with Israeli authorities over the entry of commercial trucks carrying food.

Pires recalled that supplies had been unable to enter Gaza before the ceasefire, when famine was declared by UN-backed food security experts.

"We can't go back to a situation where children and families are not getting all the supplies, goods and services that they require," he said.

Despite the continuing hardship, Unicef has helped more than 560,000 children return to learning since the ceasefire, including through more than 200 learning centres it supports.

The agency has also provided digital cash assistance to more than 380,000 people and safe water to 1.2 million people.
output: UN agency Unicef ne kaha hai ke Hamas aur Israel ke darmiyan ceasefire, yani truce, ke elaan ke baad Gaza mein 340 se zyada bachay maare gaye. Unicef ke spokesperson Ricardo Pires ne Geneva mein journalists ko bataya ke bachon ki maut ke figures ceasefire se match nahi karte. Unicef ke mutabiq pichhle do hafton mein Gaza mein 5 larke aur 2 larkiyan maare gaye, jabke kam az kam 33 bachay shadeed zakhmi hue. Uske mutabiq taqreeban 800,000 bachay be-ghar hain aur andazan 60,000 bachon ne ek ya dono parents kho diye hain, aur taqreeban har bachay ko conflict ke asraat se deal karne ke liye kisi na kisi tarah ki mental health support ki zaroorat hai. Unicef ne parties se mutalba kiya ke woh ceasefire barqarar rakhein, UN Security Council ki Resolution 2803 ko follow karein aur international humanitarian law, yani war mein aam logon ke protection ke rules, ke under apni zimmedariyan poori karein. Unicef ne kaha ke ceasefire ke baad usne 560,000 se zyada bachon ko learning mein wapas jane mein madad di hai, 380,000 se zyada logon ko digital cash assistance aur 1.2 million logon ko safe water provide kiya hai.

فرانس اپنے شہریوں کو پھٹے پرانے کپڑے اور جوتوں کو پھینک کر نئے خریدنے کی بجائے انھیں مرمت کرنے پر آمادہ کرنے کے لیے ایک بونس سکیم شروع کر رہا ہے۔

رواں سال اکتوبر سے یہ بونس ڈسکاؤنٹ کی صورت میں میسر ہو گا جس کی قیمت چھ یورو (پانچ پاؤنڈ) سے 25 یورو (21 پاؤنڈ) تک ہو گی۔

حکومت پانچ سال کے دوران بونس کی فنڈنگ کے لیے 154 ملین یورو مختص کرے گی۔

برانجے کوئلاریہ، جو ماحولیات کے جونیئر وزیر ہیں، کا کہنا ہے کہ فرانس میں ہر سال سات لاکھ ٹن کپڑا کوڑے میں پھینک دیا جاتا ہے۔

کوئلاریہ نے 'تمام سلائی ورکشاپس اور جوتا بنانے والوں سے اس سسٹم میں شامل ہونے کی اپیل کی' جس کے مطابق حکومت انھیں نئی ہیل لگانے کے لیے سات یورو اور جیکٹ، سکرٹ یا دیگر کپڑوں میں نئی ​​استر لگانے کے لیے 10 سے 25 یورو تک کی چھوٹ دے گی۔

اس سکیم کا مقصد مرمت کے شعبے کو سپورٹ کرنا اور نئی ملازمتیں پیدا کرنا ہے۔

انھوں نے کہا کہ حکومت فیشن کے جدید تقاضوں سے نمٹنے کے لیے پرعزم ہے اور صارفین کو نئی اشیا خریدنے کی بجائے ان کی مرمت کرنے کی ترغیب دینے کی کوشش کر رہی ہے۔

ری فیشن نامی ایک گروپ، جس سے اس سکیم کو قائم کرنے کے لیے کہا گیا ہے، کا کہنا ہے کہ فرانس میں گذشتہ سال کپڑے، جوتے اور گھریلو ٹیکسٹائل کی 3.3 ارب اشیا مارکیٹ میں خریداری کے لیے پیش کی گئیں۔

لیکن فرانس میں ہر کوئی حکومت کے اس طریقہ کار سے متاثر نہیں ہوا۔ کاروباری گروپوں نے اس اقدام کو فرانس کی ایک اہم صنعت کو 'بدنام' کرنے کے متصادم قرار دیا جبکہ دائیں بازو کے ریپبلکن ایم پی ایرک پاوگیٹ کا کہنا ہے کہ حکومت پہلے ہی تین کھرب یورو قرضے میں ڈوبی ہوئی ہے اور اسے 'فرانسیسی عوام کے پیسے کو اس طرح اڑانا بند کرنا چاہیے۔'

فرانس میں پائیدار فیشن کو فروغ دینے والے ایک اور منصوبے میں یکم جنوری 2024 سے عمل کرتے ہوئے کپڑے کی صنعت میں شامل ہر شے کے ماحولیاتی اثرات کی تفصیل اس پر درج ہو گی۔

نئے قوانین کے تحت مینوفیکچررز کو کپڑوں کی تیاری کے لیے پانی کی مقدار، کیمیکلز کے استعمال، مائیکرو پلاسٹک کے اخراج کے خطرات اور اس بات کی تفصیل بھی بتانا ہو گی کہ آیا اس لباس کی تیاری میں کوئی ری سائیکل شدہ ٹیکسٹائل استعمال کیا گیا یا نہیں۔

output: France apne shehriyon ko phatay puranay kapre aur joote phenkne ki bajaye unki marammat karne par tayyar karne ke liye ek bonus scheme shuru kar raha hai, jiska maqsad repair sector ko support karna aur nayi jobs paida karna hai. Refashion ka kehna hai ke France mein pichhle saal kapre, joote aur household textiles ki 3.3 billion items market mein kharidari ke liye pesh ki gayin. Right-wing Republican MP Éric Pauget ne kaha ke government 3 trillion euros qarze mein doobi hui hai. 1 January 2024 se kapre ki industry mein shamil har cheez ke environmental impact, yaani environment par padne wale effects, us par darj honge. Although France fashion ke hawale se European Union ka fourth-largest exporter hai lekin recent years mein is industry mein kami waqia hui hai.

output: Islamabad ke sarkari hospital Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) ne former Prime Minister Imran Khan ki hospital arrival par ek statement jari kiya, jis mein bataya gaya ke Shifa International aur PIMS ke doctors ne unka detailed medical examination kiya. Imran Khan ko Thursday aur Friday ki raat medical examination ke liye PIMS laya gaya, jahan Shifa International ke do eye specialists ne unki aankhon ka check-up kiya aur PIMS ke specialist doctors ne bhi detailed medical examination kiya. Aankhon ke doctors ki report aur PIMS ke doctors ke examination ki roshni mein detailed medical fitness report tayyar ki gayi, lekin Supreme Court ke orders aur patient ki privacy ke pesh-e-nazar medical report ki details zahir nahi ki ja sakti. Imran Khan ki Adiala Jail se Shifa International Hospital shifting ki deadline Thursday raat khatam honi thi.

ہائی کورٹ کے دو رکنی بنچ نے یہ حکم خضرحیات کی والدہ اقبال بانو کی درخواست پر دیا جس میں ڈیتھ وارنٹ کو چینلج کیا گیا تھا۔

لاہور ہائی کورٹ کے جسٹس شاہد حمید ڈار کی سربراہی میں دو رکنی بنچ نے درخواست پر ابتدائی سماعت کے بعد ہوم ڈیپارٹمنٹ کو بھی نوٹس جاری کر دیے ہیں۔

خضر حیات اس وقت لاہور جیل میں ہیں اور سیشن جج لاہور نے ان کے 17 جنوری کے لیے ڈیتھ جاری کیے تھے۔

خضر حیات پر الزام ہے کہ انھوں نے اپنے ساتھی کانسٹیبل کو قتل کر دیا تھا۔ مقامی عدالت نے سنہ 2003 میں خضر حیات کو موت کی سزا سنائی تھی۔

جمعرات کو خضر حیات کی والدہ کی متفرق درخواست کی سماعت ہوئی تو ان کی وکیل سارہ بلال نے بتایا کہ خضر حیات سنہ 2008 سے ذہنی اعتبار سے بیمار ہیں اور انھیں کئی مرتبہ علاج کے لیے ہسپتال بھی داخل کرایا گیا۔

خضر حیات کی والدہ کی وکیل نے بتایا کہ درخواست گزار کے بیٹے کی سزائے موت پر عمل درآمد رکوانے کے لیے ماتحت عدالت یعنی سیشن سے رجوع کیا گیا تاہم سیشن کورٹ نے گذشتہ برس اکتوبر میں خضر کی سزائے موت روکنے کی درخواست مسترد کردی تھی۔ اس فیصلے کو لاہور ہائی کورٹ میں چیلنج کیا گیا جہاں یہ معاملہ ابھی زیر سماعت ہے۔

سماعت کے دوران سارہ بلال نے اپنے دلائل میں تعجب کا اظہار کیا کہ خضر حیات کی بیماری کی وجہ سے ان کی سزائے موت پر عمل درآمد رکوانے کے لیے درخواست لاہور ہائی کورٹ میں زیر سماعت ہے اور ہوم ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے جواب کا انتظار ہے لیکن اس کے باوجود خضر حیات کی سزائے موت کے احکامات پر عمل درآمد کے لیے ڈیتھ وارنٹ جاری کر دیے گیِے۔

سارہ بلال نے استدعا کی کہ خضر حیات ذہنی اعتبار سے صحت مند نہیں ہیں اور ان کی پھانسی پر عمل درآمد روکنے کا معاملہ بھی زیر سماعت ہے اس لیے ڈیتھ وارنٹ پر عمل درآمد روک دیا جائے۔

output: Lahore High Court ne Khizar Hayat ki 17 January ko di jane wali phansi rokh di. Ye order Khizar Hayat ki walida Iqbal Bano ki petition par diya gaya. Justice Shahid Hamid Dar ki sarparasti mein do member bench ne Home Department, yaani provincial government ka woh department jo jails se related hai, ko notices jari kiye. Khizar Hayat is waqt Lahore jail mein hain aur Sessions Judge Lahore ne un ke 17 January ke liye death warrant, yaani phansi ka official order, jari kiye the. Khizar Hayat par apne saathi constable ko qatal karne ka ilzam hai aur local court ne 2003 mein unhein death sentence sunaya tha. Lawyer Sarah Bilal ne bataya ke Khizar Hayat 2008 se mentally ill hain. Sarah Bilal ne kaha ke Sessions Court ne pichhle saal October mein death sentence rokne ki application reject kar di thi. Lahore High Court ne death warrant suspend kar diya aur mazeed proceedings 15 din baad hongi.

The plea stated that in the given circumstances, the "proper course for the court was to seek advice of the medical expert on the report and thereafter decide if it discloses any worsening of the condition of the respondent".

"There is no gainsaying that Imran Khan is a convict and has to be treated in accordance with law like any other convict," it asserted.

The plea said the jurisprudence for the grant of interim relief was well settled: "a court seized of a lis (lawsuit) can only grant relief in the interim that was intermediary, and in no case final relief can be granted at the interim stage".

It went on to list the prayers made in the plea for Imran's hospitalisation, which included him being moved to Shifa International Hospital for eye treatment; access to his personal physicians who may be associated with all the procedures of examination and treatment; family members being informed about his treatment and checkup and being provided access to him at these instances; provision of his medical report/reports of checkups to his lawyers.

The government stated in its plea that the SC had accepted all four requests in totality as an interim measure. It contended that SC had decided the lawsuit at the interim stage without any notices being issued to the respondents.

"There is nothing left to adjudicate upon. Such a course is unwarranted by the law and has always been frowned upon by the Supreme Court. Therefore, the August 18 order is in violation of the settled principle of law as expounded by the Supreme Court, and accordingly, the same is liable to be set aside," the petition argued.

The petition is yet to be fixed for hearing.

According to Order IV, Rule 28 of the Supreme Court Rules as amended in 2025, the application for a review has to be fixed before the same bench that delivered the judgement — which in this case would be a three-judge bench headed by Justice Shahid Waheed and comprising Justices Naeem Akhtar Afg­­han and Ishtiaq Ibr­ahim.

The rules state that in case the author judge — Justice Waheed in this case — recuses or resigns, the application will be heard by a bench comprising one or more judges of the bench that delivered the judgement or order sought to be reviewed.

After the final disposal of the application for review, no subsequent application for a review on the same issue can be filed to the court, and the court registry will not accept any such plea, according to the rules.

In its interim order on Tuesday, the SC directed the government to shift Imran to Shifa Inte­rn­ati­onal Hospital within two days for examination and treatment by a multidisciplinary medical board.

The court also allowed his personal physician and sister to remain associated with his medical care and directed authorities to facilitate regular family contact.

The court said the directions were being issued as an interim arrangement, without prejudice to the rights and contentions of the parties, and must be complied with by the government, its officers and agencies "in letter and spirit" until the next hearing on September 16.

It further directed the government to place before it Imran's complete medical record from the date of his arrest, including tests, reports, prescriptions, medical opinions and details of treatment administered to him.

The authorities were also asked to provide details of meetings held during the preceding three months between Imran and his family members and lawyers, as well as complete details of cases in which he was accused, arrested, facing trial or had been convicted and sentenced.

The court directed authorities to facilitate meetings between Imran and his family once a week and allow him to speak to his sons by telephone twice a week.

Until the next hearing, Imran's family members, PTI members and lawyers associated with him have been barred from disclosing his health condition or medical reports to the media or public.

The court also directed the PTI and Imran's family to ensure that no public gathering took place on the hospital premises and ordered that his medical reports or information concerning his health should not be used for political purposes.

It warned that non-compliance could lead to withdrawal of facilities granted under the order.

The government was also directed to make adequate security arrangements during Imran's stay at the hospital.

Hours after the court order, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tararsaidin a video statement that the government would ask the SC to make "suitable modifications" to its order regarding Imran Khan's health, including shifting him to a government hospital for treatment instead of a private facility.

The order was issued on a set of pleas filed by the PTI,Imran himself, and his family, seeking the former premier's transfer to Shifa Inter­national Hospital, access to personal physicians, family and counsel and the disclosure of his medical details.

It came a day after the superintendent of the Adiala jail — where Imran has been imprisoned since Aug 2023 —submitteda report to the SC on the ex-premier's health condition.
output: Government ne 18 August ke interim order, yani temporary order, ke khilaf Supreme Court mein petition file ki hai. Petition mein kaha gaya ke Imran Khan saza yafta hain aur law ke mutabiq un ke saath bhi wohi treatment honi chahiye jo doosre saza yafta logon ke saath hoti hai. Supreme Court ne Tuesday ke interim order mein government ko hidayat di ke do din mein Imran Khan ko Shifa International Hospital shift karein. Court ne Imran Khan ke personal physician aur behen ko medical care se juda rehne ki ijazat di aur authorities ko hidayat di ke regular family contact ki sahulat dein. Court ne authorities ko hidayat di ke Imran Khan aur family ke darmiyan hafte mein ek baar mulaqat aur beton se hafte mein do baar telephone par baat karne ki sahulat dein. Agli hearing 16 September tak Imran Khan ke family, PTI members aur lawyers ko rok diya gaya hai ke woh un ki health condition ya medical reports media ya awam ko na batayein. Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar ne kaha ke government Supreme Court se kahegi ke Imran Khan ki health se mutaliq order mein munasib tabdeelian kare, jismein unhein private facility ke bajaye government hospital shift karna bhi shamil hai. Supreme Court ke Order IV, Rule 28 ke mutabiq jo 2025 mein amend kiya gaya, review petition, yani usi faisle par dobara ghaur ki petition, usi bench ke samne fix hogi jisne faisla diya, yani Justice Shahid Waheed ki sarparasti mein three-judge bench jismein Justice Naeem Akhtar Afghan aur Justice Ishtiaq Ibrahim shamil hain.

یہ 20 اکتوبر 2020 کی بات ہے جب سابق وزیر اعظم نواز شریف نے لندن میں صحافیوں سے بات کرتے ہوئے انکشاف کیا تھا کہ جب (امریکی صدر) کلنٹن نے افغانستان پر ٹوماہاک کروز میزائل گرائے تھے تو ان میں سے کچھ غلطی سے (پاکستان کے صوبے) بلوچستان میں آ گرے اور ان میں سے جو ایک ثابت مل گیا اسے پاکستان نے 'ریورس انجینیئرنگ' کر کے اپنا 'بابر میزائل' بنا لیا۔

اگست 1998 کے دوران اسلامی شدت پسند تنظیم القاعدہ نے کینیا اور تنزانیہ میں قائم امریکی سفارتخانوں کو بم حملوں کا نشانہ بنایا اور اس کے جواب میں امریکہ نے افغانستان میں شدت پسندوں کے ٹھکانوں کو کروز میزائل 'ٹوماہاک' سے نشانہ بنایا لیکن ایک میزائل اپنے نشانے کے بجائے غلطی سے پاکستان میں آ گرا تھا۔

پاکستان کے اس وقت کے وزیر اعظم نواز شریف نے امریکی صدر بل کلنٹن کو ٹیلیفون کر کے اس معاملے پر احتجاج بھی ریکارڈ کروایا تھا۔

اس واقعے کے بعد چند امریکی اخبارات میں ایسی خبریں بھی شائع ہوئیں کہ پاکستان اس میزائل کا بغور جائزہ لے رہا ہے تاکہ اس کی 'ریورس انجینیئرنگ' کر کے ٹوماہاک قسم کا اپنا کروز میزائل تیار کر سکے۔

ریورس انجینیئرنگ وہ طریقہ ہے جس کے ذریعے کسی بھی چیز کے تمام حصوں کو علیحدہ کر کے اس کی ساخت معلوم کی جاتی ہے اور اس کی مدد سے نئی ٹیکنالوجی تیار کی جاتی ہے۔

پاکستان کے سابق سفیر عبدالباسط کا اپنے ایک تجزیے میں کہنا تھا کہ اس وقت امریکہ نے پاکستان پر بہت دباؤ ڈالا کہ وہ پاکستان میں گرنے والے ٹوماہاک میزائل کے تمام پرزے اور حصے واپس کرے۔

اس وقت تو بہت سے ماہرین ایسے بھی تھے جن کا خیال تھا کہ شاید پاکستان اس میزائل کی ریورس انجینیئرنگ کرنے میں کامیاب نہ ہو سکے لیکن 11 اگست 2005 کو پاکستان نے اپنے پہلے کروز میزائل 'بابر' کا کامیاب تجربہ کر کے بہت سے لوگوں کو حیران کر دیا کیونکہ کروز میزائل کی ٹیکنالوجی دنیا میں چند ہی ممالک کے پاس تھی، جن میں پاکستان بھی شامل ہو چکا تھا۔

حال ہی میں انڈیا کا آواز سے تین گنا تیز چلنے والا سپرسانک کروز میزائل پاکستان کے علاقے میاں چنوں میں گرا ہے۔ انڈیا کی وزارت دفاع نے ایک بیان میں اعتراف کیا کہ نو مارچ کو پاکستان کی حدود میں گرنے والا میزائل حادثاتی طور پر انڈیا سے فائر ہوا تھا جس کی 'اعلیٰ سطح پر تحقیقات' کا حکم دے دیا گیا ہے۔

پاکستان کا کہنا ہے کہ انڈیا کی جانب سے یکطرفہ کورٹ آف انکوائری کے ذریعے اس حادثے کی تحقیقات کا فیصلہ ناکافی ہے کیوںکہ یہ میزائل پاکستان کی حدود میں گرا، اس لیے پاکستان مطالبہ کرتا ہے کہ اس واقعے کے حقائق طے کرنے کے لیے مشترکہ تحقیقات کی جائیں۔

تاہم سرحد کے دونوں جانب حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ میزائل 'ان آرمڈ' یعنی غیر مسلح تھا اور اس سے کوئی جانی نقصان نہیں ہوا۔

اس دوران بہت سے لوگوں کے ذہنوں میں یہ سوال پیدا ہو رہا ہے کہ آیا پاکستان ایک بار پھر انڈین میزائل کے ملبے کی 'ریورس انجینیئرنگ' کر کے اس قسم کا میزائل بنا سکتا ہے؟

پاکستانی فوج کے شعبہ تعلقات عامہ آئی ایس پی آر کے ڈائریکٹر جنرل بابر افتخار نے ذرائع ابلاغ کو تفصیلات سے آگاہ کرتے ہوئے بتایا تھا پاکستان حدود میں داخل ہونے والا 'انڈین پروجیکٹائل' زمین سے زمین تک مار کرنے والا سپرسانک میزائل تھا جبکہ پاکستانی فضائیہ کے ایک آفسر کا کہنا تھا کہ انھوں نے اس میزائل کا ملبہ تحویل میں لے لیا ہے اور وہ اس کا فارنزک جائزہ لے رہے ہیں تاکہ اس کے بارے میں مزید معلومات حاصل کی جا سکیں۔

انڈیا کی جانب سے جاری ہونے والے سرکاری بیان میں واضح طور پر نہیں کہا گیا کہ حادثاتی طور پر فائر ہونے والا میزائل کون سا تھا۔

تاہم پاکستان کا دعویٰ ہے کہ ابتدائی جانچ پڑتال سے معلوم ہوا کہ یہ میزائل سپرسانک کروز میزائل تھا جو آواز کی رفتار سے تین گنا فاصلہ طے کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے اور یہ پاکستان کی حدود میں تین منٹ 44 سیکنڈ تک رہنے کے بعد گر کر پاکستان کی سرحد میں 124 کلومیٹر اندر آ کر تباہ ہوا۔
output: 20 October 2020 ko Nawaz Sharif ne London mein journalists se kaha ke Clinton ke Afghanistan par fire kiye gaye Tomahawk missiles—yaani guided cruise missile—mein se kuch ghalti se Balochistan mein gir gaye. August 1998 mein al-Qaeda ne Kenya aur Tanzania mein US embassies par bomb hamle kiye, jawab mein US ne Afghanistan mein Tomahawk cruise missiles dagay. Ek missile ghalti se Pakistan mein gira, Nawaz Sharif ne Bill Clinton ko telephone kiya aur protest record karwaya. American newspapers mein khabrein aayin ke Pakistan missile ka jaiza le kar reverse engineering—yaani kisi cheez ko dekh kar us jaisi copy banane ka process—se Tomahawk type ka cruise missile bana sakta hai. 11 August 2005 ko Pakistan ne apna pehla cruise missile Babur kamyabi se test kiya. Haal hi mein India ka supersonic cruise missile, jo sound se 3 guna tez hai, Pakistan ke area Mian Channu mein gira. India ki Ministry of Defence ne kaha ke 9 March ko Pakistan ki borders ke andar girne wala missile ghalti se fire hua, aur high-level investigation ka order diya. Pakistan ne unilateral Court of Inquiry—yaani sirf ek side ki apni investigative court—ko insufficient kaha aur joint investigation—yaani dono mulk mil kar tahqeeq—ka mutalba kiya.
